description: This C# source file defines the class SubscriptionMultiplicityTestRunner, which contains various asynchronous test methods for verifying subscription behaviors in Orleans streaming tests, including multiple subscription scenarios, resubscriptions, deactivations, and client subscriptions.

classes.name: SubscriptionMultiplicityTestRunner
classes.description: A test runner class for verifying multiple subscription behaviors in Orleans streaming tests, including parallel, linear, add/remove, resubscription, deactivation, and client subscription scenarios.

methods.name: MultipleParallelSubscriptionTest
methods.description: Tests multiple parallel subscriptions to a stream, producing messages, and verifying counters.

methods.name: MultipleLinearSubscriptionTest
methods.description: Tests sequential subscriptions, unsubscriptions, and message production, verifying counters at each step.

methods.name: MultipleSubscriptionTest_AddRemove
methods.description: Tests adding and removing subscriptions dynamically, verifying counters.

methods.name: ResubscriptionTest
methods.description: Tests resubscribing to a stream after initial subscription.

methods.name: ResubscriptionAfterDeactivationTest
methods.description: Tests resubscribing after the consumer grain has been deactivated.

methods.name: ActiveSubscriptionTest
methods.description: Verifies multiple active subscriptions and their management.

methods.name: TwoIntermitentStreamTest
methods.description: Tests intermittent streams with two different stream namespaces.

methods.name: SubscribeFromClientTest
methods.description: Tests client-side subscription to a stream and message counting.

methods.name: CheckCounters
methods.description: Internal method to verify that produced and consumed message counts match expectations.

methods.name: RunFor
methods.description: Executes a given async function repeatedly for a specified duration.
